candidates.name: stacker
candidates.description: a combiner fitted to pick winners: the market line and the calibrated Valve rating (one logit scale per format) as base inputs, own_rating, per_map_rating and the VRS and HLTV rank gaps as extras (a missing one reads as no shift), fitted on the Events that ended before. Objective: the weights minimise the log-loss penalised towards the anchor; the penalty, which sets how far the fit moves from the anchor, is chosen from 1/3/10/30/100/1000 by accuracy (share of winners picked at probability above one half) on the latest third of the training Events, refitted on the training Events before them (ties: lower log-loss, then the larger penalty); so the side it picks is that of the setting that picked most winners on Matches it was not fitted on, and its probability stays a log-loss fit
candidates.reason: the interval of the log-loss difference includes zero
